appUrl.description: URL of the app, from the primary ingress or route, eg `https://app.example.com/`. Without either, it points to `127.0.0.1`.

podCIDR.description: CIDR of the pods, from `global.podCIDR`, defaults to `172.16.0.0/16`.

svcCIDR.description: CIDR of the services, from `global.svcCIDR`, defaults to `172.17.0.0/16`.

items.description: Host and port of a service, eg `release-app.namespace.svc.cluster.local:8080`.

internalUrls.description: Internal URLs of the services of the chart.

description: Details about the release that common works out on every render, to use in Helm `tpl` strings such as `{{ .Values.chartContext.appUrl }}`. Common sets these keys itself and replaces values set here.
